modules.title: 普通请求和 WebSocket 的连接方式对比
两种方式的消息延迟从哪来

items.title: 轮询会等下一轮检查
items.text: 新消息可能要等下一轮才被发现；间隔越短，请求越多。

items.title: WebSocket 可主动发送消息
items.text: 连接可让服务器主动发送消息；实际延迟仍受服务端处理、队列、网络和客户端渲染影响。

items.title: 双向都能发
items.text: 不只是服务器推：客户端也可以随时通过同一条连接发消息。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: WebSocket 不保证连接不断：网络切换、服务重启都会断开，需要自动重连。它适合“双方频繁互发”的实时场景；普通页面读取用普通请求即可，不必上长连接。

lessonPractice.title: 聊天室用“每秒问一次服务器有没有新消息”实现。会出现什么问题？

options.label: 每秒请求大部分是空查询，浪费请求且有延迟；实时场景该用长连接
options.feedback: 对。高频轮询会产生许多空请求，消息还要等下一轮才发现；WebSocket 可在连接可用时主动发送，但实际延迟仍受处理和网络影响。

options.label: 每秒查一次已经足够实时，没有问题
options.feedback: 一条新消息可能要等接近一个轮询间隔才被发现，且绝大多数查询没有新消息。

options.label: 把页面做大一点，能同时显示更多消息
options.feedback: 页面容量与消息到达速度无关；问题在获取消息的方式。

en.title: A chat room is implemented by asking the server every second whether there are new messages. What problem does this cause?

options.label: Most per-second requests are empty polls, wasting requests and adding delay; real-time should use a persistent connection
options.feedback: Correct. High-frequency polling creates empty requests, and a new message waits for the next check; WebSocket can send proactively while connected, though processing and network delay still apply.

options.label: Checking every second is real-time enough, no problem
options.feedback: A message may wait nearly one polling interval for the next check, and most checks find nothing.

options.label: Make the page bigger so more messages show at once
options.feedback: Page capacity is unrelated to message arrival speed; the issue is how messages are fetched.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 聊天室现在每秒轮询新消息。请改用 WebSocket：连接建立后保持打开，新消息到达即推送。断线要自动重连；改完后在开发者工具的 Network 面板确认是长连接，并测试断网恢复后能继续收到消息。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: The chat room currently polls for new messages every second. Switch to WebSocket: keep the connection open after it is established and push messages as they arrive. Auto-reconnect on disconnection; afterward confirm it is a persistent connection in the Network panel and test that messages resume after a network recovery.

learning.assumes: You have used chat rooms or real-time notifications, or heard of long connections.
learning.outcome: In developer tools you can tell a persistent connection from a one-off request.

modules.title: Where message delay comes from in each

items.title: Polling waits for the next check
items.text: A new message may wait for the next check; shorter intervals mean more requests.

items.title: WebSocket can send proactively
items.text: An open connection lets the server send proactively, but actual delay also depends on server work, queues, network, and client rendering.

items.title: Both sides can send
items.text: It is not just server push: the client can send anytime over the same connection.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: A WebSocket does not guarantee the connection never drops: network switches and server restarts disconnect it, so auto-reconnect is needed. It fits real-time scenarios with frequent two-way traffic; ordinary page reads work fine with ordinary requests.

distinctions.label: Ordinary HTTP request
distinctions.text: An HTTP request and response form one message exchange, but the underlying connection can be reused; after its handshake, WebSocket exchanges messages in both directions.

distinctions.label: Streaming response
distinctions.text: Streaming is one-way server push; a WebSocket is bidirectional, so the client can send anytime too.
